title: Amazing quality for the price
text: Amazing quality for the price. These frames are really nice and easy to put together (my teenager put it together) and I bought two.  They don't creek or make noises while you lay on them and tall enough to store stuff underneath and they are pretty.

product_metadata.title: DUMEE Metal Queen Bed Frame with Headboard and Footboard Farmhouse Platform Bed Frame Queen Size Under Bed Storage No Box Spring Needed, Textured Black
features: High-quality Queen Bed Frame: Strong mattress support with 11 steel slats prevents sagging and increases mattress life. Newly improved double middle rows of support system with 10 legs make the platform metal bed frame more superior heavy-duty and solid. Maximum support arounds 350-550lbs.
Classical Design: A generous and durable appearance of the bedframe, not easy to go out of fashion. The vintage queen headboards are in perfect match with other furnitures.
BedFrame Dimension: Queen size bed frame as 60.2"(width)x83.54"(length)x43.5"(headboard height), 12" height off the floor offering sufficient space for under-bed storage bins, bags and drawers.

Easy Assembly: Bedframe queen-size comes flat-packed in one box for easy home assembly. All parts and tools are clearly labled, instruction included. Very easy to assemble, no box spring needed (mattress not included).
Worry-Free Warranty: 12-months warranty and 100% customer satisfaction after-sales service for DUMEE bed frames, free replacement parts available. Any questions please feel free to contact us.
